recommendation_title: Focus Q next on billing: free-tier Premium-only controls
recommendation: Put next quarter's product effort into billing_support, specifically the free-tier packaging issue where core playback controls (song choice, skips, rewind, lyrics) are locked behind Premium [C001][C002]. This single issue has the highest priority score of any issue in the pack (175,269 [C004], from 59,334 complaints [C001] at mean severity 2.953939 [C003]), well ahead of the next-ranked actionable issue, and it carries 11,677 cancellation-intent mentions [ISS-BILLING-PREMIUM_ONLY_CONTROLS]. The issue has also sharply escalated in recent months, moving from roughly 3-4% monthly share for most of the window to 17.13% in 2023-09 and 29.31% in 2023-10, making it both the biggest and the fastest-growing concern worth addressing now.

alternatives.title: usability
alternatives.why_not_first: usability has the highest raw complaint_count (75,546) but a lower mean_severity (2.370185) and severity_sum (179,058) than billing_support's top single issue alone, and its leading sub-issues (ads C009/C010, redesign C017/C018) rank below the top billing issue in priority score.

alternatives.title: playback
alternatives.why_not_first: playback shows high severity concentration (sev4plus 11,434, mean_severity 3.195346) but its largest issue, stops/skips, has a priority score of only 44,320 [C016], far below the top billing issue's 175,269 [C004].

alternatives.title: access
alternatives.why_not_first: access has the highest mean_severity of any area (3.839357) but the smallest complaint volume (12,811) and its top issue, login failures, scores only 31,486 [C028] in priority, making it a smaller-scope problem this quarter.
